command.title: Command centre
command.connect_hint: Attach AurionBridge to the chart you want here. AURION never invents candles, fills or equity. This banner leaves as soon as the EA is online, and returns when the last EA is removed.

markets.loading_tf: Fetching real CopyRates history from the attached EA…

ai.title: Intelligence
ai.conf_help: Confidence is the model probability of the next move, then scaled by how many live candle votes agree (pattern, EMA, MACD, DI, RSI). Chop and tiny ATR cut the score. The Robot number is the minimum required for a robot entry.
ai.auto_learn: Learns automatically from live EA candles
ai.no_chart_data: No AI read on this chart yet — it appears after its first closed candle

strategies.title: Strategies
strategies.none: No strategy selected — engine will not send entries
strategies.hint: Turn a strategy on. Then arm Auto-trade. The robot learns on every closed bar and only sends live orders when a strategy fires.
strategies.single_rule: One strategy at a time — switching one on turns the others off. Stats below update after every closed trade.
strategies.waiting: Waiting for the next closed bar
strategies.file_hint: Choose a .py file or paste source. The file is saved on this desk and can be enabled like the built-ins.
strategies.news_help: When off, the robot stays out of the news window. Applies to normal and scalping.
strategies.news_locked: Locked by the active prop profile (news filter).
strategies.confirm_delete: Delete strategy %s? Its .py file is removed and this cannot be undone.
strategies.ai_gate_help: When on, the robot only opens a trade when the AI direction agrees with the signal. Turn it off to let the strategy trade on its own.
strategies.min_conf_help: Minimum AI confidence for a robot entry. 55% is a balanced default — go higher for fewer but safer entries, lower for more (noisier) entries.
strategies.lot_help: How the robot sizes every entry.
strategies.lot_auto_sub: Auto: each strategy trades with its own preset volume (Normal 0.10, Scalping 0.05).
strategies.lot_manual_sub: Manual: the robot opens every entry with exactly this lot — on all symbols.

risk.title: Prop risk
risk.prop_on: Prop rules are ON — orders must pass the profile
risk.prop_off: Prop rules are OFF — the robot can trade freely
risk.preset_locked: Factory preset — rules cannot be edited. Switch to Custom to write your own book.

exec.pick_tp: Click the chart to place take-profit

settings.title: Settings
settings.password_note: Stored only on the engine host. Never sent to the browser after save.
settings.goto_prop: All prop fields live in Settings
settings.saved_offline: Saved to your account. Engine is offline — connect later.

style.title: Trade model
style.normal_hint: Swing / intraday. Wider stops, M15 and higher.
style.scalping_hint: Fast in and out. Tighter stops, M1 impulse allowed.

wizard.title: Connect a live terminal
wizard.step1: Start MetaTrader 5 on this machine or your VPS
wizard.step2: Tools → Options → Expert Advisors: allow algo trading and WebRequest for 127.0.0.1, http://127.0.0.1, http://127.0.0.1:18765 and http://127.0.0.1:8080
wizard.step3: Compile AurionBridge.mq5 1.17 (F7) and attach it. Experts must show “hello delivered v1.17” or “file inbox writing” — WebRequest is optional.
wizard.step4: Run stop-aurion.cmd then start-aurion.cmd, then Ctrl+Shift+R on the desk. If the card is still missing, read the Experts tab.
